description: A dark, oil-painted crowd of cut-out style figures in mixed dress stands behind four figures in bright military band uniforms with blank faces. A large bass drum sits mid-frame and a smiling clown-faced drum lies lower right. Red flowers in the foreground form large letters reading roughly BEAT. There are palms, a doll and small statues. The painting fills the image edge to edge, with no frame.
